ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, which are confined to narrow linear features and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark, low-intensity pigmentation across the macro-surface of both lobes; no contiguous high-contrast geometric blobs or mottling patterns are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a wide pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced irregular peaks observed on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex mathematical curve from the notch to the tips, with a sharp upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated clusters of high-contrast white pixels are visible near the outer tips and along the trailing edge, suggesting localized focal points of prior colonization or contact.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A high density of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) are mapped across the entirety of both lobes, intersecting the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of superficial rake marks across the ventral surface and a series of unique nicks and serration peaks along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of nearly 100% dark base pigmentation with an exceptionally high density of fine-line linear scarring creates a unique visual fingerprint.
